config.label: Base URL of the Agent Wikis instance to query
config.description: Base URL of the Agent Wikis instance to query. Defaults to https://agentwikis.com; set to point at a self-hosted/private instance.

config.label: Agent Wikis Pro API key
config.description: Agent Wikis Pro API key. When set, open_wiki, search, and read_document include the Pro (XL) tier; without it the server serves the free tier only.
